mapper.select: SELECT DATE(o.payment_time) AS orderDate, SUM(o.total_amount) AS totalAmount, COUNT(o.id) AS totalNum FROM order_info o WHERE o.order_status > 0 AND o.payment_time >= CONCAT(#{createDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND o.payment_time < DATE_ADD(#{createDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(o.payment_time)
